name: Oracle Elemental Guardian
body:
Your spellcasting and powers come from your singular dedication and attunement to one of the four classical elements: earth, air, fire, or water. Perhaps your motivation is to maintain balance, or perhaps it is unbridled power you crave. In any case, by dedicating yourself solely to the study of your chosen element, you become a champion of one of the four primal forces of the Multiverse.

Favored Element

At 1st level, select a favored element: air, earth, fire, or water. Your choice of element determines your mystery, as well as several other class features. Depending on your favored element, you gain access to a list of bonus spells (see below). These spells are considered part of your spell list, although you must still select them as normal in order to learn them. At the same time, you are prohibited from learning the spells on your opposed element’s list, and they are removed from your class spell list if they are normally part of it. So strong is this taboo that it even extends to other class spell lists if you are multiclassed. You do not automatically add either all cure or all inflict spells to your list of spells known, but can still select them normally as spells known.

Air: You are prohibited from using spells on the earth bonus spell list (below) or with the earth descriptor. You must choose wind as your mystery.
Earth: You are prohibited from using spells on the air bonus spell list (below) or with the air descriptor. You must choose stone as your mystery.
Fire: You are prohibited from using spells on the water bonus spell list (below) or with the water descriptor. You must choose flame as your mystery.
Water: You are prohibited from using spells on the fire bonus spell list (below) or with the fire descriptor. You must choose waves as your mystery.

This feature replaces curse and modifies spells.

Weapon And Armor Proficiency

You are proficient with all simple weapons, plus the handaxe, kama, nunchaku, sai, short sword, shuriken, and siangham. You are proficient with light armor but not with shields. In addition, you receive Improved Unarmed Strike as a bonus feat.

This feature modifies weapon and armor proficiency.

Elemental Fist

At 1st level, you gain Elemental Fist as a bonus feat, even if you do not meet the prerequisites. When you gain this ability, you must choose the energy type associated with your favored element: air (electricity), earth (acid), fire (fire), or water (cold). You can only use this energy type with your elemental fist attacks. You can use this feat a number of times per day equal to your oracle level. At 5th level, the energy damage dealt by your Elemental Fist attacks increases to 1d8. At 9th level, it increases to 1d10. At 13th level, it increases to 2d6. At 17th level, it increases to 2d8.

This feature replaces the revelation normally gained at 1st level.

Elemental Mastery

Upon reaching 20th level, you become a master of your favored element. Any time you cast a spell from your elemental bonus spell list, you can add any one of the following feats to it without increasing the spell level or casting time: Enlarge Spell, Extend Spell, Silent Spell, or Still Spell. You must have the feat in question in order to apply it. You gain one of these feats as a bonus feat at 20th level.

This feature replaces final revelation.

Bonus Spell List — Air Element
Level 0 (Orisons): daze, guidance
Level 1: air bubble, alter winds, expeditious retreat, feather fall, jump
Level 2: air step, gust of wind, levitate, silence, sound burst, storm sight AG
Level 3: air breathing, carrying wind, cloak of winds, fly, lightning conductor, second wind, wall of mist, wind wall
Level 4: air walk, blast of wind, cloud shape, river of wind, tailwind
Level 5: communal air walk, control winds, fickle winds, summon monster V [air elementals only]
Level 6: cloudkill, sirocco, wind walk
Level 7: control weather, mass fly
Level 8: wandering weather, whirlwind
Level 9: winds of vengeance.
Bonus Spell List — Earth Element
Level 0 (Orisons): acid splash, mending
Level 1: magic stone, mighty fist of the earth, pass without trace, sanctuary, stone shield
Level 2: barkskin, bear’s endurance, bull’s strength, ironskin, magic boulder, stone call
Level 3: iron stake, meld into stone, spike growth, stone shape, trial of fire and acid
Level 4: earth glide, spike stones, wall of stone
Level 5: passwall, sawtooth terrain AG, stoneskin, summon monster V [earth elementals only]
Level 6: dust form, mass bear’s endurance, mass bull’s strength, move earth, stone tell
Level 7: statue, terraform MA
Level 8: earthquake, repel metal or stone
Level 9: clashing rocks.
Bonus Spell List — Fire Element
Level 0 (Orisons): flare, spark
Level 1: burning hands, cause fear, dancing lantern, faerie fire, sun metal, touch of combustion
Level 2: cat’s grace, fiery shuriken, flame blade, fury of the sun, heat metal
Level 3: continual flame, daybreak arrow, discovery torch, trial of fire and acid
Level 4: fire shield, healing flames, healing warmth, pyrotechnic eruption, quench, scorching ash form, wall of fire
Level 5: fire snake, flame strike, summon monster V [fire elementals only]
Level 6: chains of fire, contagious flame, fire seeds, mass cat’s grace
Level 7: fire storm, sunbeam
Level 8: incendiary cloud
Level 9: fiery body.
Bonus Spell List — Water Element
Level 0 (Orisons): create water, ray of frost
Level 1: bless water, diagnose disease, hidden spring, marid’s mastery, obscuring mist, touch of the sea, waterproof
Level 2: aboleth’s lung, communal water walk, delay poison, holy ice weapon, slipstream, spindrift spritz, unholy ice weapon
Level 3: communal delay poison, create food and water, water breathing, water walk
Level 4: control water, mass spindrift spritz, neutralize poison, ride the waves, rising water, tail current
Level 5: geyser, holy ice, summon monster V [water elementals only], unholy ice
Level 6: cold ice strike, fluid form
Level 7: expel blood, ice body, speak with waves, vortex
Level 8: seamantle
Level 9: tsunami.
